title: What Makes a Good Semantic ID for Generative Recommendation? A Reproducibility Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.24430v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation has emerged as an active research direction, where items are commonly represented by semantic IDs (SIDs): discrete codes generated token by token. Despite strong empirical results, SID designs vary widely in construction strategy, codebook organization, and code length, making their true impact on recommendation performance unclear.   We conduct a large-scale reproducibility study to systematically investigate the impact of semantic ID design on generative recommendation under a unified experimental framework. We focus on a fundamental question: What makes a good semantic ID for generative recommendation? To answer this question, we examine four aspects: the relative effectiveness of different semantic ID designs, the connection between codebook utilization and recommendation quality, the effect of semantic code length, and the influence of semantic ID design on local item semantic preservation. translated_title: 什么构成了生成式推荐中好的语义ID？一项可复现性研究
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐已成为一个活跃的研究方向，其中物品通常由语义ID（SIDs）表示：即逐个token生成的离散编码。尽管实证效果显著，但SID设计在构建策略、码本组织和码长等方面差异很大，使其对推荐性能的真实影响尚不明确。我们开展了一项大规模可复现性研究，在统一的实验框架下系统性地考察语义ID设计对生成式推荐的影响。我们聚焦于一个基本问题：什么才是生成式推荐中好的语义ID？为回答这一问题，我们考察了四个方面：不同语义ID设计的相对有效性、码本利用率与推荐质量之间的关联、语义码长的影响，以及语义ID设计对局部物品语义保留的影响。通过统一的实验框架……
tldr: 本文通过大规模可复现性研究，在统一实验框架下系统考察了语义ID设计（包括构建策略、码本利用率、码长和局部语义保留）对生成式推荐性能的影响，以回答“什么才是好的语义ID”这一基本问题。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a large-scale reproducibility study under a unified experimental framework to systematically investigate how semantic ID design choices—including construction strategy, codebook utilization, code length, and local semantic preservation—affect generative recommendation performance.
